systems.country_label: guichet unique; Numéro Personnel d'Identification (NPI); RAVIP
systems.owner: Agence Nationale d'Identification des Personnes (ANIP), with the WURI project and UNICEF
systems.tiers: ten public health facilities in a six-month pilot from 20 August 2025 to February 2026; certificates online or at ANIP's own counters; not at the mairie

note: The national identity agency's one-stop birth registration pilot in ten hospitals; the mairie is named only as where parents no longer need to go, and nothing is stated about its connection.
